scientific_integrity: The global exact-real proof uses the phase sine recursion and summable remainder estimates. Finite diagnostics are corroborative, not proof; a related 2022 article was accessible only at abstract level.
scientific_limitations: Results apply only at a=-1 to exact-real forward dynamics. Other parameters, finite-precision effects, physical basins and cryptographic security are not analyzed. Publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Critical square-root escape and logarithmic phase delay in a symmetric sine-offset map
